identificationModule.briefTitle: This Study is to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of ZD6474 in Subjects With Metastatic Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Multicenter Phase II Study to Assess the Response of Subjects With Metastatic Breast Cancer Previously Treated With Anthracycline and Taxane Therapy With or Without Capecitabine to ZD6474 (100-mg or 300-mg Daily Oral Dose).

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to assess the efficacy of ZD6474 in patients with metastatic breast cancer at 2 dose levels.
